Value: Five projects making our school greener: what they are, how they are doing, and how you can help.
Illustration of the main school building, with solar panels on the roof and rain trees by the lake

Every number here is measured or worked out by pupils. Living wall plants are counted on the first Monday of each month. Rainwater is read from the water meter on each tank. Solar electricity is our estimate, worked out from the area of the panels, until the real meter readings replace it. Farm harvests are weighed on kitchen scales. The Sustainability Group checks the readings and updates this dashboard every two weeks.
